value.title: SC asks HDFC Bank, three others to ok staff prosecution
value.summary: The Supreme Court has ordered HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Sammaan Capital, and PNB Housing Finance to grant prosecution sanctions. This order pertains to allegations concerning fraudulent subvention schemes involving real estate developers and financial institutions. Homebuyers were subjected to loan recovery proceedings, even when builders failed to meet their financial obligations. The banks must comply within a week or their heads will have to appear in court.
